CustomField.label: BindGroupSize
CustomField.description: How many bind items ride in one callout. MEASURED, never assumed: ruling 6 of the 3 August inbox. Time one small call, then choose. Lives in config rather than Apex because the next measurement will move it and a constant in Apex would make a measured number look like a design decision.
